plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Motion Graphics, Graphic Communications, AAS' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/graphic-communications-motion-graphics-aas/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid, hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. The catalog defines its plan footnotes on this page: 1 = 'See approved General Education list for the AAS Degree', 2 = 'See program recommendations or requirements', 3 = 'See Graphic Communications Faculty Adviser for graphic communications elective requirements' — those slots are modeled as choice slots with those definitions; see advisor. The schedule grid also includes unnamed 3-unit rows with no footnotes (3rd and 4th semesters); they are modeled as choice slots with an honest 'not defined on this page; see advisor' note. Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid.
